info.title: CEOMENTALITY frontend integration contract
info.description: Target contract consumed by the current frontend. No backend is implemented in this repository. Amounts are integer kopecks. See backend-handoff.md for state transitions, authorization and idempotency requirements.

get.summary: Initialize HttpOnly session and return CSRF token
Current prices and availability; unique entry for each variant

post.summary: Validate access code and grant server-side purchase access
Exchange QR token for session-bound membership access
Accept application only for a valid claimed invitation
Calculate authoritative item prices and delivery without placing an order
Atomically create one order from an unexpired session-bound quote
Exchange emailed token for session-bound order access

get.summary: Return order only for its authorized session

post.summary: Return provider payment URL; never accept card data

sessionCookie.name: ceo_session
sessionCookie.description: Server-issued HttpOnly Secure SameSite cookie; not read by JavaScript.

paymentUrl.description: HTTPS URL on a configured paymentOrigins origin.

invitation.description: Optional referral code; does NOT authorize the QR-gated form.
